city.summary_zh: 山谷嬉皮小镇，月租竹屋为主（฿5,000–9,000），光纤约 50 Mbps；3–4 月烧荒烟雾、雨季河水需注意。
city.summary_en: A hippie valley town; monthly bamboo houses run THB 5,000-9,000 with ~50 Mbps fibre; watch the Mar-Apr burn-season smoke and rainy-season river water.

neighborhoods.name: 步行街中心
neighborhoods.vibe: 夜市商圈，咖啡馆与社交中心，步行可达一切
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 nomads.one 步行街一带房间 ฿5,000–7,000 中值（฿34/$）

neighborhoods.name: 河东岸·湄延
neighborhoods.vibe: 竹屋吊床、稻田河景，极安静
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 nomads.one 河东岸 ฿7,000 与 Mae Yen 走廊 ฿4,000–5,500 区间中值

neighborhoods.name: 桑吉村
neighborhoods.vibe: 云南村，茶与手拉面，清晨云雾
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 nomads.one 桑吉村带家具房间 ฿5,500–7,000 中值

neighborhoods.name: 拜峡谷西线
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 nomads.one 峡谷路一带竹屋 ฿6,500–9,000 中值

sources: https://www.nomads.one/thailand/pai/ — 月成本 ฿15,000–30,000、片区与租金区间、光纤 50–60 Mbps（头图均值 20 Mbps 口径冲突，种子网速 55 居中保留）
